title: WEATHER FORECAST FOR 26 JULY 2026 Issued at 2.00 p.m. on 25 July 2026 A few showers will occur in the Western, Sabaragamuwa and North-western provinces and in Galle and Matara districts. Mainly dry weather will prevail over the other areas of the island. Strong winds about (40-50) kmph can be expected at times over Western slopes of the Central hills, Northern and North-central provinces and in Hambantota, Trincomalee and Puttalam districts.
